ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows a transition-state drawing with a fused bicyclic heavy-atom framework: a left six-membered ring fused to a right heterocyclic ring containing N. The drawing also shows an OH-type oxygen attached near the top central carbon, an OEt substituent attached at the upper-right center, and a methyl substituent attached at the lower-right ring carbon. Several curved arrows are present, but they are not bonds and must be ignored. Hydrogens are shown on O/H positions, but bonds involving hydrogen are excluded. Reasoning following the assigned counting method: Count the heavy-atom bonds directly from the drawing. The fused-ring framework is counted first: the left six-membered ring contributes its 6 perimeter heavy-atom connections. The right ring contributes 5 additional perimeter heavy-atom connections because one edge is shared with the left fused ring. Thus the ring/core framework has 6 + 5 = 11 heavy-atom bonds. Next count the non-hydrogen substituent bonds: lower-right ring carbon to methyl = 1, upper-right center to OEt oxygen = 1, OEt oxygen to ethyl carbon = 1, ethyl carbon-carbon bond = 1, and the upper OH oxygen heavy-atom bond to the central carbon = 1. These add 5 substituent heavy-atom bonds. Total = 11 + 5 = 16.

method.method_draft: Build the heavy-atom graph. Treat the fused core as two six-membered rings sharing one bond: 6 ring edges + 6 ring edges - 1 shared edge = 11 heavy-atom core bonds. Expand the external fragments seen in the image: methyl attachment gives 1 edge; OEt gives central carbon-O, O-ethyl carbon, and ethyl carbon-carbon = 3 edges; the top oxygen/OH attached to the central carbon gives 1 edge. The graph therefore has 11 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 16 non-hydrogen bonds.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个过渡态结构，主体为两个稠合的六元环，共用一条边；右下环中有一个 N 原子。右下侧连有一个甲基支链，右上侧中心碳连有 OEt 取代基，顶部还连有一个含氧/OH 片段。图中还有弯箭头和氢标注，但题目要求忽略箭头并排除涉及氢的键。推理：按重原子图计数，稠合双六元环核心可看作两个六元环共享一条键，因此核心键数为 6 + 6 - 1 = 11。外部片段中，甲基与核心相连贡献 1 条非氢键；OEt 片段包含中心碳-O、O-乙基碳、乙基碳-碳，共 3 条非氢键；顶部氧/OH 与中心碳相连贡献 1 条非氢键。总数为 11 + 1 + 3 + 1 = 16。
